To be tabled
1. To table the address made to the joint session of the Federal Parliament.
Vote of Thanks
The Honorable Speaker will present the following vote of thanks for the address made by the Right Honorable President:-
2. "This meeting of the House of Representatives expresses its gratitude to the Right Honorable President for the address made to the joint session of both houses of the Federal Parliament on Monday, Baishakh 28, 2083, in accordance with Article 94 of the Constitution of Nepal."
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The agenda includes tabling the address made by the President to the joint session of the Federal Parliament. Following this, a vote of thanks for the President's address will be presented.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The Speaker will present a vote of thanks to the President for the address delivered to the joint session of both houses of the Federal Parliament on Baishakh 28, 2083, as per Article 94 of the Constitution.
key_issues: Vote of thanks to the President
